name: Tempester n°46: the Save/Load browser lists a folder in one directory pass
explanation: Tempester n°46: the Save/Load browser lists a folder in one directory pass instead of n * 2n (Main 1.5.0.2). Before: [routine](type, folder) ([address], entered from the browser through n°35's INVAL) counts the files ([routine]), then gets name i (i = 0..count-1) with [routine] -> [routine] -> [routine], which recounts and rewalks the directory from its start each time: file count-1-i in directory order (first entry skipped, "." and ".." not counted) goes to list entry i ([address] + 0x20 * i, name, raw index i at +0x1C), then qsort(list, count, 0x20, [routine]). 9,161 directory reads for 76 files (feature-ui-fixes.md §4): the slow file screen of Docs/analyses/bugs-open-2026-11.md §14, for sounds, beats and projects alike. After: at the loop (after [routine] and the drive selection, s2 = count, s3 = type, s4 = folder), FAST walks the directory once (path of [routine] as [routine], change directory, first entry skipped, "." and ".." skipped) and writes the k-th file into entry i = count-1-k, raw index i: the very entry, string and raw index the factory loop gives it, so qsort sees the same array and returns the same list. The name is copied up to 28 characters, bytes 0-27 of the entry, as the factory strcpy leaves them before the raw index overwrites bytes 28-31 (longer names are cut there instead of overflowing the next entry). Then the factory qsort and return. When the fast pass cannot vouch for the factory result (count 0 or above 256, the list's size; directory change refused; more or fewer files than counted), the factory loop runs as before. n°35's Load Sound list (same 0x20-byte entries, same comparator) is untouched: its own builder, and INVAL still clears its tag before this runs. Context: main loop (UI). No RAM of its own (stack frame of 0x100 bytes, as n°35's BUILD). Flasher page untouched.

edits.why: j 0x9d07a700 ; [routine], entries from the count and the three drive paths: was "blez s2,[address]" (redone by FAST); delay slot "clear s1" kept
beq t0,zero,0x9d07a7dc ; count 0 or above 256: the factory loop (nothing / as before)
jal [address] ; first entry, skipped as in [routine]
addiu a1,sp,0x60 ; directory entry (152 bytes, name at +1)
beq t0,zero,0x9d07a7d8 ; more files than counted
sw t6,0x1c(t4) ; raw index i, as the factory loop
bne s1,s2,0x9d07a7d8 ; fewer files than counted
j [address] ; factory qsort of the list and return 1
or s1,zero,zero ; delay slot: i = 0, as the replaced delay slot
j [address] ; count <= 0: nothing to list (the replaced "blez s2,[address]")
